about: Every input of mapping release 1.2 (crew_mapping.py release-large), pinned by hash like pins.json and large-pins.json. The Missions recipe is that of dataset release 1.1; the target is the manifest of the large Personnel v2 snapshot, whose pages are checked against the hashes in it. A run refuses to start when a pin differs; the release repeats the pins in crew.json and participants.json. Changing a pin is a deliberate act: python -B federation/personnel-mapping/crew_mapping.py pins --write --pins-file federation/personnel-mapping/release-large-pins.json.
